[[Zoldark's Rod]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Zoldark's Chest]], a [[chest]] that spawns after defeating the Dungeon Boss [[Zoldark The Unholy]] in the [[Vloxen Excavations]].

==Stats==
:[[Dark damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Soul Reaping]])
:[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)
:[[Energy]] +15
:Energy regeneration -1
